reason: The SMS-lock half of the claim holds. When a user or team is LOCKED, scheduleSMS returns undefined (twilioProvider.ts:90-95, 144-181), so the new else branch in scheduleSMSReminders.ts:178-187 adds 1 to retryCount without logging, and the deleteMany at :38-42 removes the reminder once retryCount > 1. Before the patch the reminder stayed queued until scheduledDate. The rate-limit half is wrong: checkSMSRateLimit does not throw. At the monthly limit it only sets REVIEW_NEEDED (checkRateLimitAndThrowError.ts:40-45), which is not LOCKED, so the SMS is still sent; only a failed lock-state update (e.g. user.update finding no record because of the `profiles: none` filter at :58-66) would land in the catch.
